heading: AI usage limits
description: Cap how much AI each member, role or the whole institute can use per day, week or month. Limits count list credits, so included and free usage counts too.
loadFailed: Couldn't load usage limits. Try again in a moment.

mode.title: How limits behave
mode.description: Start with Preview to see who a limit would stop, then switch to Enforce once the numbers look right.

OFF.label: Off
OFF.help: Limits are saved but not checked. AI works exactly as it does today.

SHADOW.label: Preview
SHADOW.help: Every AI call is checked and logged as 'would block', but nothing is stopped.

ENFORCE.label: Enforce
ENFORCE.help: A member who reaches a hard limit is stopped until the period resets. Soft limits show a warning.

mode.enforceLocked: Enforce has to be enabled for your institute by {{brand}}.
mode.enforceLockedNote: Enforce is locked for your institute. Use Preview to measure the impact; contact {{brand}} to unlock enforcement.
mode.globallyPaused: Enforcement is paused across the platform right now, so Enforce currently behaves like Preview.
mode.notify: Email admins at the soft limit
mode.notifyHelp: One email per limit per period when usage crosses the soft limit.
mode.showNumbersHelp: When on, learners see how much of their allowance is used. When off they only see that a limit was reached.
mode.reasonPlaceholder: Why are you changing this? (saved in the change log)

usage.title: Current usage
usage.description: Usage counted against your limits in the current period.
usage.empty: No limited usage in this period yet.

rows.title: Your limits
rows.description: Each limit applies to one feature scope and one period. A member's own limit replaces their role limit; institute-wide pools and platform limits always apply too.
rows.offNote: Limits are Off, so these rules are saved but not checked. Switch to Preview to start measuring.
rows.empty: No limits yet. Add one to cap AI usage for a role, a member or the whole institute.

platform.title: Set by {{brand}}
platform.description: Platform limits (for example a plan's fair-use cap) always apply and can't be changed here.
platform.lockedTooltip: Set by {{brand}}. You can't edit or override this limit.

decision.OVERRIDDEN: Replaced by a more specific rule

toasts.deleteFailed: Couldn't remove the limit. Please try again.

delete.title: Remove limit
delete.body: Remove the limit for {{subject}} on {{feature}}? Usage already counted is kept.

dialog.instituteHint: One shared pool for everyone in the institute.

errors.subject: Choose who this applies to.
errors.scope: Choose the feature or feature group.
errors.softAboveHard: Warn at can't be higher than the limit.
errors.noLimit: Set a warning level, a limit, or both.

dialog.editNote: Only the warning level and the limit can be changed. To change who or what this limit covers, remove it and add a new one.
dialog.roleHint: A custom role has to be mapped to a role group by {{brand}} before it can be limited; until then, limit its role group.
